topic: how to pay amazon chase credit card
slug: how to pay amazon chase credit card

steps.narration: Open the Chase app and sign in.
Tap your Amazon Rewards Visa card on the home screen.
Choose how much to pay: current balance, statement balance, or another amount.
Choose the account to pay from under "Pay from".
Choose the payment date, then tap "Continue".
Review the details and tap "Schedule payment".
The confirmation screen shows your Amazon Rewards Visa payment has been scheduled.
